sentences.en: and Megan L.
sentences.zh: 和梅根·L.

sentences.en: said, question for Jenna.
sentences.zh: 说，有个问题要问珍娜。

sentences.en: In this episode, when Jim is showing Pam his parents' house, I was wondering what went
sentences.zh: 在这集里，当吉姆向潘展示他父母的房子时，我很想知道你是怎么考虑

sentences.en: into how you decided to play this scene?
sentences.zh: 来诠释这场戏的？

sentences.en: Because she seems really worried and unexcited, but then in the end, she says she loves it.
sentences.zh: 因为她看起来真的很担忧、一点也不兴奋，但最后，她说她很喜欢。

sentences.en: Any input you could give about how you decided to play this or what the director told you
sentences.zh: 关于你是如何决定这样演的，或者导演跟你说了什么，

sentences.en: would be super appreciated.
sentences.zh: 如果你能分享一下，我们将感激不尽。

sentences.en: Well, guys, we've already discussed my personal opinions on someone buying someone else a house
sentences.zh: 好吧，伙计们，我们之前已经讨论过我对于“有人不打招呼就

sentences.en: without telling them.
sentences.zh: 给别人买套房子”这一行为的个人看法。

sentences.en: So this was a little bit of a mental gymnastics for me to get Pam to the place where she's
sentences.zh: 所以为了让潘达到说出她很喜欢、说出那句台词的状态，

sentences.en: going to say she loves it and where she says that line.
sentences.zh: 我确实经历了一番心理挣扎。

sentences.en: I mean, you bought me a house because it was like not how I would react as Jenna.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你竟然给我买了一栋房子，因为这跟我作为珍娜的真实反应不太一样。

sentences.en: You know, I had to really play the character and play the character's truth.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我必须真正进入角色，演绎出角色的真实心境。

sentences.en: And in the script, I was being told that my character's truth was that she loved this gesture
sentences.zh: 剧本告诉我说，我角色的真实心境是她深爱着这个举动，

sentences.en: and it made her feel loved.
sentences.zh: 这让她感到了被爱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I think we often did that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，我觉得我们以前经常那样做。

sentences.en: Obviously, we had to play the truth for the character.
sentences.zh: 很显然，我们必须展现角色的真实心境。

sentences.en: I mean, I hope you guys know I'm not very much like Angela Martin and how I would react
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，希望你们知道我跟安吉拉·马丁在面对事情时的反应大不相同，

sentences.en: to things, but it made sense to me, Jenna for Pam, you know, and Jim made the garage
sentences.zh: 但这对我来说很合理，珍娜懂潘，你知道的，吉姆把车库

sentences.en: into this art studio and he's really putting down some roots with her.
sentences.zh: 改造成了这个艺术工作室，而且他真的在和她一起扎根生活。

sentences.en: And I think Pam wanted a family and she wanted all of these things that Jim is offering her.
sentences.zh: 我想潘渴望一个家庭，她渴望吉姆提供给她的所有这一切。

sentences.en: She had wanted that.
sentences.zh: 她一直都想要这些。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, I had thought a little bit back on The Talking Head where Pam discusses what
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我回想了一下之前的那段访谈，潘在里面讨论过

sentences.en: her perfect home would look like, how she always wanted a home with a terrace.
sentences.zh: 她理想中的家是什么样的，她一直想要一个带露台的家。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You know, picking her home seemed like something that Pam was attached to.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，挑选她自己的家似乎是潘很在乎的一件事。

sentences.en: So I did bring that up.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实提过这件事。

sentences.en: I said, you know, we've established that Pam has daydreamed about what her home would look
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道的，我们已经确定帕姆曾幻想过她的家会是什么

sentences.en: like.
sentences.zh: 样。

sentences.en: And now this person has taken her out of the process.
sentences.zh: 而现在这个人却把她排除在这个过程之外。

sentences.en: You brought that up to the writers at the time of when we were filming?
sentences.zh: 你在我们当时拍摄的时候向编剧们提过这件事？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so I was saying, like, help me understand why Pam now is so happy and so excited.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在说，帮我理解一下为什么帕姆现在这么高兴、这么兴奋。

sentences.en: And Angela, we got to exactly what you just said, which was that it was a vulnerable thing
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们得出了你刚才所说的结论，那就是放弃艺术学校的轨道

sentences.en: for Pam to give up the art school track.
sentences.zh: 对帕姆来说是一件很脆弱的事情。

sentences.en: And she did that because of two reasons.
sentences.zh: 她这么做是因为两个原因。

sentences.en: One, graphic design wasn't what she meant she wanted to do as an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 第一，平面设计并不是她作为一个艺术家真正想做的事情。

sentences.en: And two, she's ready.
sentences.zh: 第二，她准备好了。

sentences.en: She's very, very ready to start living this married life, to be in the season of family
sentences.zh: 她非常非常准备好开始过这种已婚生活，和这个她等了多年的男人一起

sentences.en: and marriage with this man that she's been waiting years for.
sentences.zh: 进入家庭和婚姻的阶段。

sentences.en: And so this home is her fast track to that season of her life.
sentences.zh: 所以这个家是她通往人生那个阶段的快车道。

sentences.en: And she's just ready.
sentences.zh: 她已经准备好了。

sentences.en: And, you know, they're going to get to fix it up together.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他们会一起装修它。

sentences.en: So there's still that element of nesting that's going to get to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以仍然会有那种筑巢的元素会发生。

sentences.en: And so that's kind of what I was thinking was like, I'm ready.
sentences.zh: 所以这也就是我当时的想法，就像是，我准备好了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And you have to think, when Pam talked about her dream house with this tower and the terrace
sentences.zh: 你得想想，当帕姆谈论她带着塔楼和露台的梦想中的房子

sentences.en: and all of that, she was in an unhappy relationship.
sentences.zh: 以及诸如此类的事情时，她正处于一段不快乐的感情中。

sentences.en: When you're in a place you feel stuck in life or you're unhappy, you daydream.
sentences.zh: 当你处在一个在生活中感到困顿或不快乐的地方时，你就会做白日梦。

sentences.en: And you daydream about these fantastical things and their coping mechanisMs.
sentences.zh: 你会对这些奇异的事情做白日梦，它们是应对机制。

sentences.en: And then when you're with someone you really love, you don't need the fantasy anymore.
sentences.zh: 然后当你和真正爱的人在一起时，你就不再需要这种幻想了。

sentences.en: That's such a good point, Angela.
sentences.zh: 这真是个极好的观点，安吉拉。

sentences.en: You're just ready to have a life.
sentences.zh: 你只是准备好过一种生活了。

sentences.en: And she's ready to have that life.
sentences.zh: 而她已经准备好过那种生活了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Now, we did get some mail about that garage.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们确实收到了一些关于那个车库的来信。

sentences.en: Katie C.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·C.

sentences.en: and Chris G.
sentences.zh: 和克里斯·G.

sentences.en: said,
sentences.zh: 说：

sentences.en: When Jim is showing Pam his parents' house, he says the garage has great lighting.
sentences.zh: 当吉姆向帕姆展示他父母的房子时，他说车库光线很好。

sentences.en: He then proceeds to open a windowless garage door, revealing a completely windowless garage space.
sentences.zh: 接着他去打开一个没有窗户的车库门，露出了一个完全没有窗户的车库空间。

sentences.en: Where's the great lighting, Jim?
sentences.zh: 好光线在哪里，吉姆？

sentences.en: Where?
sentences.zh: 在哪里？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, I thought that was really funny.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得这真的很好笑。

sentences.en: That is really funny.
sentences.zh: 这确实很好笑。

sentences.en: I want you guys to know that I have a garage that we use as a home office.
sentences.zh: 我想让你们知道，我有一个用作家庭办公室的车库。

sentences.en: And for a long time, we would just raise the door.
sentences.zh: 在很长一段时间里，我们只是把门拉起来。

sentences.en: And then there would be amazing light, you know?
sentences.zh: 然后就会有惊人的光线，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And so it did get great light, but you had to raise the door.
sentences.zh: 所以它的确光线很好，但你得把门拉起来。

sentences.en: And then years later, we actually just removed the door because we're like,
sentences.zh: 然后多年后，我们实际上直接把门拆掉了，因为我们在想，

sentences.en: this is never going to be a garage again.
sentences.zh: 这永远不会再成为一个车库了。

sentences.en: You know, we've sort of made it into this little home office and put an actual sliding glass door.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们有点把它改造成了这个小小的家庭办公室，并装了一扇真正的推拉玻璃门。

sentences.en: But I get it.
sentences.zh: 但我懂。

sentences.en: It does have great lighting.
sentences.zh: 它确实光线很好。

sentences.en: You just have to open it up.
sentences.zh: 你只需要把它打开就行。

sentences.en: But he does present it like this garage has great lighting, as if the other garages that you open,
sentences.zh: 但他把这个车库说得好像采光极好一样，就好像你打开别的车库，

sentences.en: the whole side of the building, wouldn't have great lighting.
sentences.zh: 也就是整栋建筑的一侧，采光就不会好似的。

sentences.en: He's presenting as if it's like a special feature that kind of applies to every garage
sentences.zh: 他把这说得像是什么特殊功能，其实这种功能适用于任何

sentences.en: that doesn't have like a giant tree planted in front of it, which it wouldn't because it's a garage.
sentences.zh: 前面没有种着一棵大树的车库，本来就不会有，因为这就是个车库。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Most garages are just boxes with no windows.
sentences.zh: 大多数车库都只是没有窗户的盒子。

sentences.en: I have to tell you two things about shooting these scenes at the house.
sentences.zh: 关于在房子里拍这些场景，我有两件事要告诉你们。

sentences.en: Scene where Jim is trying to take the clown painting off the wall for Pam is one of the hardest I've ever laughed on the show.
sentences.zh: 吉姆帮潘把小丑画从墙上取下来的那场戏，是我在这部剧里笑得最惨的几次之一。

sentences.en: It is the second hardest time.
sentences.zh: 这是我笑得第二惨的一次。

sentences.en: The first was when we did the scene in Dinner Party where Michael's showing us the tiny TV on the wall.
sentences.zh: 最惨的一次是我们拍《晚餐派对》那场戏时，迈克尔给我们展示墙上那个超小电视。

sentences.en: This is the second.
sentences.zh: 这个是第二。

sentences.en: Every time John tried to lift the painting on the wall, I could not stop laughing.
sentences.zh: 每次约翰试图把墙上的画抬起来时，我都笑得停不下来。

sentences.en: I don't know what it was.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Tears, tears, choking on our laughter.
sentences.zh: 眼泪，眼泪直流，笑得都快噎住了。

sentences.en: We laughed so hard.
sentences.zh: 我们笑得太厉害了。

sentences.en: I looked for it in the bloopers and it's not there.
sentences.zh: 我在花絮里找过这段，但里面没有。

sentences.en: And I'm so upset it's not there.
sentences.zh: 没能收录进去让我很难过。

sentences.en: It took us like an hour to shoot that tiny moment of him trying to take the painting off the wall.
sentences.zh: 我们花了大约一个小时才拍完他试图把画从墙上取下来的那个小片段。

sentences.en: John is also so funny at physical comedy.
sentences.zh: 约翰在形体喜剧方面也太有天赋了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I laughed out loud when he peeled back that fake wood paneling and it kind of startled him.
sentences.zh: 当他揭开那层假木饰面板并被吓了一跳时，我忍不住笑出了声。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So then at the end of the scene in the garage, when we're hugging, I improvised the line, what about the clown?
sentences.zh: 所以在车库那场戏的结尾，当我们拥抱时，我即兴加了一句台词：“那小丑怎么办？”

sentences.en: And it made John laugh.
sentences.zh: 这把约翰逗笑了。

sentences.en: And that's why he's like burying his head into my neck.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他把头埋在我的脖子里。

sentences.en: And then when he said, yeah, I can't do anything about that, it made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 然后当他说“对啊，我对那个没办法”时，我也笑了。

sentences.en: And so I'm like smushing my face into his shoulder.
sentences.zh: 所以我把脸使劲埋进了他的肩膀里。

sentences.en: You can totally tell we're breaking.
sentences.zh: 你完全看得出来我们笑场了。

sentences.en: And that's why it was because we were still, anytime we brought up the clown painting, we lost it.
sentences.zh: 原因就是我们当时只要一提到小丑画，就会彻底破功。

sentences.en: I love that moment.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢那个瞬间。

sentences.en: It made it intimate and funny and sweet.
sentences.zh: 它既亲密、搞笑又甜蜜。

sentences.en: I think it's time to talk about the greatest Dwight talking head of all time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是时候聊聊史上最棒的德怀特单人访谈了。

sentences.en: That's saying a lot because there are some amazing Dwight talking heads, but this one really is like top five.
sentences.zh: 这话分量不轻，因为德怀特的精彩访谈有很多，但这个绝对能排进前五。

sentences.en: He's going to describe his perfect crime.
sentences.zh: 他要描述他完美的犯罪计划了。

sentences.en: And I think we have to hear it.
sentences.zh: 我想我们必须听听看。

sentences.en: What is my perfect crime?
sentences.zh: 我完美的犯罪是什么？

sentences.en: I break into Tiffany's at midnight.
sentences.zh: 我在午夜潜入蒂芙尼珠宝店。

sentences.en: Do I go for the vault?
sentences.zh: 我去撬保险箱吗？

sentences.en: No, I go for the chandelier.
sentences.zh: 不，我直奔水晶吊灯。

sentences.en: It's priceless.
sentences.zh: 它无价之宝。

sentences.en: As I'm taking it down, a woman catches me.
sentences.zh: 当我把它取下来时，一个女人抓住了我。

sentences.en: She tells me to stop.
sentences.zh: 她叫我住手。

sentences.en: It's her father's business.
sentences.zh: 这是她父亲的产业。

sentences.en: She's Tiffany.
sentences.zh: 她就是蒂芙尼。

sentences.en: I say no.
sentences.zh: 我说不。

sentences.en: We make love all night.
sentences.zh: 我们缠绵了一整夜。

sentences.en: In the morning, the cops come and I escape in one of their uniforMs.
sentences.zh: 清晨，警察来了，我穿着他们的制服逃跑了。

sentences.en: I tell her to meet me in Mexico, but I go to Canada.
sentences.zh: 我让她去墨西哥找我，但我去了加拿大。

sentences.en: I don't trust her.
sentences.zh: 我不信任她。

sentences.en: Besides, I like the cold.
sentences.zh: 再说了，我喜欢冷。

sentences.en: Thirty years later, I get a postcard.
sentences.zh: 三十年后，我收到了一张明信片。

sentences.en: I have a son, and he's the chief of police.
sentences.zh: 我有个儿子，他是警察局长。

sentences.en: This is where the story gets interesting.
sentences.zh: 故事从这里开始变得有趣了。

sentences.en: I tell Tiffany to meet me in Paris by the Trocadero.
sentences.zh: 我让蒂凡尼在巴黎的特罗卡德罗找我汇合。

sentences.en: She's been waiting for me all these years.
sentences.zh: 这些年来她一直在等我。

sentences.en: She's never taken another lover.
sentences.zh: 她从没有找过别的伴侣。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: I don't show up.
sentences.zh: 我没有去。

sentences.en: I go to Berlin.
sentences.zh: 我去了柏林。

sentences.en: That's where I stashed the chandelier.
sentences.zh: 那是我藏吊灯的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I do not know how Rain got through saying, this is where the story gets interesting.
sentences.zh: 我真不知道雷恩是怎么把“故事从这里开始变得有趣了”这句话说完的。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Every time I watched this episode, I laughed at that line.
sentences.zh: 每次我看这一集，我都会被那句台词逗笑。

sentences.en: And I watched it like three times.
sentences.zh: 而且我看了大概有三遍。

sentences.en: This entire talking head was scripted, and it was delivered as scripted.
sentences.zh: 这一整段访谈都是按剧本写的，而且完全是照剧本念的。

sentences.en: I think this is one of the most brilliantly written pieces ever.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是史上最精彩的剧本之一。

sentences.en: It's just so good.
sentences.zh: 真的是太棒了。

sentences.en: It's so good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And who better to deliver it than Rainn Wilson as Dwight?
sentences.zh: 还有谁比饰演德怀特的雷恩·威尔逊来演绎更合适的呢？

sentences.en: It was just perfect.
sentences.zh: 简直完美。

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: There you have it, everyone.
sentences.zh: 各位，就是这样。

sentences.en: That's frame Toby.
sentences.zh: 那是陷害托比。

sentences.en: Did you have anything else, Angela?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你还有别的要说的吗？

sentences.en: I don't have anything else.
sentences.zh: 我没什么要说的了。

sentences.en: I do want you guys to know, because Jen and I both watched the bloopers,
sentences.zh: 我确实想让你们知道，因为珍和我两人都看了NG花絮，

sentences.en: next week on The Surplus was one of the hardest I've ever laughed in a scene.
sentences.zh: 下周播出的《盈余》那集是我拍戏时笑得最惨的一次之一。

sentences.en: Oh, I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 哦，我都等不及了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much to Randy Cordray, James Carey, and Jen Salata and Paul Lieberstein.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢兰迪·科德雷、詹姆斯·凯里、珍·萨拉塔和保罗·利伯斯坦。

sentences.en: I traded some emails with them as well.
sentences.zh: 我也跟他们通过一些电子邮件。

sentences.en: Man, that was fun.
sentences.zh: 天哪，太有趣了。

sentences.en: That was a delight.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种享受。

sentences.en: I will be trying to clean my microwave using your method.
sentences.zh: 我会尝试用你的方法来清理我的微波炉。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And we'll see you here next week.
sentences.zh: 我们下周在这里再见。

sentences.en: I'll be back in LA next week.
sentences.zh: 我下周会回洛杉矶。

sentences.en: I wonder, will I bring New York Jenna home with me?
sentences.zh: 我在想，我会把“纽约珍娜”带回洛杉矶吗？

sentences.en: We'll see.
sentences.zh: 我们走着瞧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: New York Jenna might get the E next to our podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 纽约珍娜可能会让我们的播客旁边出现个“E”标志（不适宜儿童）。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: What can I say?
sentences.zh: 我能说什么呢？

sentences.en: See you next week, guys.
sentences.zh: 大家下周见。

sentences.en: See you next week.
sentences.zh: 下周见。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to Office Ladies' Second Drink.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听《办公室女士：第二杯》。

sentences.en: This episode was initially created in collaboration with Earwolf.
sentences.zh: 本期节目最初是与Earwolf合作制作的。

sentences.en: Office Ladies is a presentation of Odyssey and is produced by Jenna Fisher and Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 《办公室女士》是奥德赛公司推出的节目，由珍娜·费舍尔和安吉拉·金西制作。

sentences.en: Our senior producer is Matt Beagle.
sentences.zh: 我们的资深制作人是马特·比格尔。

sentences.en: Our Second Drinks episodes are produced by Molly Nugent.
sentences.zh: 我们的“第二杯”系列节目由莫莉·纽金特制作。

sentences.en: Our audio engineer is Sam Kiefer.
sentences.zh: 我们的音频工程师是萨姆·基弗。

sentences.en: Odyssey's executive producer is Leah Reese Dennis.
sentences.zh: Odyssey 的执行制片人是莉亚·里斯·丹尼斯。

sentences.en: Office Ladies was mixed and mastered by Bill Schultz.
sentences.zh: 《Office Ladies》由比尔·舒尔茨进行混音和母带处理。

sentences.en: Our theme song is Rubber Tree by Creed Bratton.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲是克里德·布拉顿的《Rubber Tree》。
